ops.value: Customer personal data, payout records and points data are encrypted at rest and in transit; the business holds the keys and rotates them at least once a year.

ops.question: How does a customer prove who they are before the portal shows receipt items or their requests (REFUNDS 03 Customer identity), and which party signs a member in (LOYALTY/UC-01 Preconditions)?
ops.impact: Sets the customer identity sources (SEC-02) and may add an external identity integration (INT-01) that the SDD designs.
